fatal_gates.F1: control, prior terminal evidence, committed assignment state, and durable checkpoints remain immutable except at declared commit points
fatal_gates.F2: no richer-mode/manual-user/external hosted optimizer, finite quota, or incremental monetary cost

guards: G1 each committed switch durably records the reverse move attribute before the next selection decision
G2 the immediate reverse move is tabu for exactly two subsequent committed selection decisions
G3 a tabu candidate that does not meet aspiration cannot switch, alter credit, or erase its resumable evidence
G4 tabu tenure decays only on committed selection decisions, not wall-clock time or failed transport attempts
G5 aspiration threshold is predeclared: same-scope independently readback utility must exceed the best accepted utility by more than 1.0
G6 aspiration comparison must be same-scope and terminal-readback-qualified; hypothetical or incomparable scores cannot override tabu
G7 a genuinely aspirational reverse move is allowed despite remaining tabu tenure, preventing permanent freeze
G8 stale/duplicate completions remain fenced and prior terminal evidence remains immutable
G9 transport/CAS/readback failure is non-semantic and cannot age tabu tenure or create credit
G10 bounded exact-scope exit with nonempty frontier; independent terminal readback before any new credit

candidate_patterns.pattern: no recent-move memory; accept each locally better reversal immediately
fixed freeze forbids every reverse move for the entire leaf regardless of new evidence
persist reverse-move tabu tenure 2; reject ordinary reversal; allow same-scope independently evidenced reversal only when aspiration > best+1.0
delegate oscillation control to an external hosted optimizer

trace_precommit.required_credit_rule: blocked candidate gets zero; aspirational switch eligible only after its terminal evidence is independently read back

score_rule: Fatal F1/F2 failure => 0. Otherwise one point per G1-G10 PASS. Do not modify tenure, aspiration margin, or guards after public source read.
credit_rule: No credit for precommit/source match. At most one credit after a source-qualified Chat-native tabu/aspiration reduction passes this exact trace and terminal evidence is independently read back.
